verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a cloud or self-hostable feature-flag service, so the axis applies. The pack never documents retention periods, deletion controls, or data-purge capabilities. Related items (Edge keeps targeting PII local, external metrics stay in your Prometheus, self-hosting option) concern data locality and minimization, not controlling retention or deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
